# Fabric AI

> The complete agent engineering platform for software development teams.

Fabric is a platform where engineering teams design, build, and deploy AI agents that understand their entire codebase, connect to any tool via MCP, and automate the software delivery lifecycle — from planning to code generation to review.

## Core Capabilities

- **Context-Aware AI Agents**: Agents that ingest and reason over your codebase, documentation, and project history
- **MCP Integration**: 100+ Model Context Protocol server integrations for connecting agents to external tools and data sources
- **Weave Multi-Agent Orchestration**: 6 specialized agents (Thread, Spindle, Shuttle, Weft, Warp, Pattern) that collaborate on complex engineering tasks
- **Durable Workflows**: Temporal-backed execution with human-in-the-loop checkpoints, automatic retries, and crash recovery
- **AI-Powered SDLC**: Generate PRDs, user stories, technical specs, code, and reviews from project context
- **Multi-Provider AI**: Bring your own API keys — supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral, and 10+ more providers
- **Semantic Search (RAG)**: Vector-indexed project knowledge for contextual retrieval across all agents

## Plans

- Free: Personal use, limited agent runs
- Pro: $29/month (7-day free trial), full platform access
- Enterprise: Custom pricing, dedicated support, SSO, audit logs
